name: extract
title: ContextGem Extract
description: Extract structured data from text, a pasted document or an attached file. Input: JSON {"text"|"file_path", "aspects":[{"name","description"}], "concepts":[{"type","name","description"}], "engine":"llm"|"decision_model"|"auto", "pipeline":"<saved name>"}. Attached files are used as the document (needs the docling extra).

name: doctor
title: ContextGem Doctor
description: Check the Python environment, the ContextGem install, the optional docling extra, which Enconvo LLM provider would run through the chat bridge, and whether Jev answers closed questions — and print what to fix when something is off. Run with the input setup to create or repair the environment in one shot.

name: extract_structured
title: extract_structured
description: Extract aspects and typed concepts from a document with ContextGem. Returns each concept's and aspect's items with values, optional justifications, source references and decision-model probabilities, plus usage stats. Needs the plugin's environment: check /status, create it with /setup. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link ExtractParams}

text.description: The document text. Give this or file_path

file_path.description: Absolute path of a file to convert with Docling (needs the docling extra). Give this or text

pipeline.description: Name of a pipeline saved with pipeline_save; its aspects, concepts and engine apply unless the request sets its own

aspects.description: Nested aspects found within this one

concepts.description: Concepts extracted from this aspect's text

reference_depth.description: What a reference is: paragraphs or sentences

add_justifications.description: Attach the model's justification to each item

aspects.description: Nested aspects found within this one

type.description: Value type: string, boolean, numerical, date, rating, json_object or label

description.description: What the value means and where it appears; be specific

classification_type.description: label only: multi_class (exactly one) or multi_label (any number). Default multi_class

rating_scale.description: rating only: the inclusive scale, e.g. [1, 5]

numeric_type.description: numerical only: int, float or any. Default any

structure.description: json_object only: field names to types (string, integer, number, boolean, array, object, any); objects nest, a one-item list types an array's items

add_references.description: Attach the source text each item came from

reference_depth.description: What a reference is: paragraphs or sentences

add_justifications.description: Attach the model's justification to each item

justification_depth.description: How detailed a justification is: brief, balanced or comprehensive

singular_occurrence.description: string only: expect one value per document rather than a list

concepts.description: Concepts extracted from this aspect's text

reference_depth.description: What a reference is: paragraphs or sentences

add_justifications.description: Attach the model's justification to each item

type.description: Value type: string, boolean, numerical, date, rating, json_object or label

description.description: What the value means and where it appears; be specific

classification_type.description: label only: multi_class (exactly one) or multi_label (any number). Default multi_class

rating_scale.description: rating only: the inclusive scale, e.g. [1, 5]

numeric_type.description: numerical only: int, float or any. Default any

structure.description: json_object only: field names to types (string, integer, number, boolean, array, object, any); objects nest, a one-item list types an array's items

add_references.description: Attach the source text each item came from

reference_depth.description: What a reference is: paragraphs or sentences

add_justifications.description: Attach the model's justification to each item

justification_depth.description: How detailed a justification is: brief, balanced or comprehensive

singular_occurrence.description: string only: expect one value per document rather than a list

engine.description: llm (default), decision_model (booleans, labels and ratings only; needs the Decision Engine set to Jev) or auto (closed concepts to Jev, the rest to the LLM)

dry_run.description: Build and validate the plan without calling any model

segmentation.description: How the text is split into paragraphs: newlines (default) or sat (a model)

llm_provider.description: Enconvo LLM provider to use, e.g. anthropic, z_ai, open_ai or a custom one such as open_ai_ab12. Defaults to the user's default LLM in Enconvo

llm_model.description: Model for that provider, e.g. claude-haiku-5-5. Defaults to the provider's selected model

llm_options.description: Direct LiteLLM access to any endpoint: model, api_base, api_key, temperature, num_retries, ... Skips the Enconvo provider and both bridges; other keys also pass through as overrides

decision_threshold.description: 0-1: how sure Jev must be before a yes is a yes (Decision Engine set to Jev only)

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the run is stopped (30-3600); defaults to the Extraction Timeout preference

name: pipeline_delete
title: pipeline_delete
description: Delete a saved extraction pipeline by name. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link PipelineDeleteParams}

name.description: Name of the saved pipeline to delete

name: pipeline_list
title: pipeline_list
description: List the saved extraction pipelines with their description, default engine and how many aspects and concepts each holds. @param {Request} request - Request object; the body is unused

name: pipeline_save
title: pipeline_save
description: Save an extraction spec (aspects and/or concepts) under a name so extract can run it with just {pipeline, text}. Saving an existing name replaces it. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link PipelineSaveParams}

name.description: Pipeline name: a slug of lowercase letters, digits and dashes, up to 64 characters

description.description: What this pipeline extracts and from which kind of document

aspects.description: Document sections to find (same shape as extract's aspects)

concepts.description: Typed values to extract (same shape as extract's concepts)

engine.default: llm Default engine: llm, decision_model or auto

name: setup
title: setup
description: Create or repair the plugin's private Python environment (uv-managed venv under the plugin's support directory) and install contextgem into it. Idempotent: running it again upgrades contextgem. Takes minutes with docling. @param {Request} request - Request object, body is {@link SetupParams}

install_docling.description: Also install contextgem[docling] for PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and HTML support (large download). Defaults to the Install Docling preference

python_bin.description: Python to build the venv from; defaults to the Python Binary preference, then auto-detect of 3.11-3.14

name: status
title: status
description: Read-only health check: is a supported Python present, is the plugin's venv built, is contextgem (and the optional docling extra) importable, is the runner bundled, and which Enconvo LLM provider and model would run and whether a decision model is set. Never returns a key. @param {Request} request - Request object; the body is unused
